description: The long-range record aircraft associated with Chkalov's 1937 transpolar flight, kept in the museum hangar and marked URSS-N025. Construction number recorded as ANT-25-2. Memorial museum to Valery Chkalov in his home town, with an aircraft hangar behind the house. Free access. Data from the russianplanes.net museum register (museum 313).
